identity.title: [v0.92][WP-04.16b2] Govern learner, joint, and final voter membership transitions

values.review_scope: Exact membership coordinator and narrow PolisRuntime/MembershipState/AuthorityMembership integration, real secure OpenRaft transition tests, issue proof/evidence, typed issue truth, and absence of #200 or operational side effects.
review_prompts: Can any caller route, learner, removed voter, stale node, leader, or local history choose a voter, role, Raft id, or authority cut?
Does the coordinator use standard OpenRaft learner and membership APIs while proving exact committed joint and final configurations?
Is pending removal denied from every new authority surface without falsely claiming a #200 concrete fence mutation?
Can restart or leadership change reconcile every phase without duplicate side effects or incomplete parity publication?
Does governed rejoin ignore retained voting state until new authorization, certificate, catch-up, joint/final commitment, and parity complete?
Does proof bind the exact thirty-six cases, real secure nodes, protected-source drift, immutable evidence, strict Clippy, and merge topology?
